description: Curated hosted surface for stakeholder acceptance analysis. Operator-local configuration remains broader.

brand_slug.description: Brand overlay for rendering. Derived from the run owner; an operator may override.

decision_summary.description: The decision, proposal, or change whose stakeholder acceptance should be analysed.
decision_summary.x-ask: What decision or proposed change should the stakeholder analysis assess?

input_set.description: Optional finalized input-set handle (inputset:<uuid>) from create_input_session/finalize_input_session. The runner rehydrates the uploaded documents into the run's raw-inputs folder, where document loading picks them up alongside anything orchestrated sourcing gathers. Tier 2, with no default: absent simply means no client-supplied documents.

probability_transform.description: How a stakeholder's aggregated driver score becomes a probability. `linear` (the default) carries the scoring rubric's own anchors through — its 1 = ~5% / 10 = ~95% ladder — so the transform does not re-decide the calibration. `logistic` is the legacy second calibration on top of that: it agrees near the middle and compresses the tails (10 -> 0.88), and exists only to reproduce a pre-2026-09 run. `identity` is the raw 0-100% map with no band. Tier 2: a visible default a client may change.

run_cluster_identification.description: Discover and consolidate the stakeholder set from evidence. Provider-locked ON: the only alternative source of stakeholders is workflow.inputs.realities_path, which is not part of the hosted surface, so a hosted run with this off has nothing to analyse and initialize_workflow rejects it.

run_collector.description: Extract evidence excerpts and map each to a stakeholder and driver — the ledger every score must cite. Tier 2.

run_driver_discovery.description: EXPERIMENTAL, provider-locked off. Discovers additional drivers from the corpus, which makes the analytical frame vary per run and forfeits run-to-run comparability — the property this workflow exists to provide.

run_graph_enrichment.description: Relationship extraction and entity/cluster alignment — two halves of one optional feature whose only effect on the answer is the context notes handed to scoring. Off by default. Tier 2.

weighting_mode.description: How driver weights are set within a stakeholder. `category_balanced` (the default) gives each driver CATEGORY equal total weight, split among its members, so the taxonomy cannot vote: under plain `equal`, a category the registry happens to express as seven drivers outweighs one expressed as two, and adding a driver for descriptive reasons moves the conclusion. `configured` requires explicit driver_weights and triggers the HITL review; `llm_ranked` derives them from a ranker. Tier 2: a visible default a client may change.
